user.title: AirPlay Bridge
user.description: Normally the add-on announces itself and you only confirm. Manual setup: address and port of the add-on (127.0.0.1 and 8099 on Home Assistant OS) and the token from the add-on log.

hassio_confirm.title: AirPlay Bridge
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the AirPlay speakers of the add-on {addon} in Home Assistant? Their entities are added to the Echos' devices.

reauth_confirm.title: AirPlay Bridge
reauth_confirm.description: The add-on no longer accepts the token (e.g. reinstalled). Enter the new token from the add-on log.

error.cannot_connect: Add-on not reachable. Is it running?

abort.already_configured: AirPlay Bridge is already set up.
